definition.cv_fde: mean deterministic last-observed-displacement FDE over independent complete 8+12 windows using opentraj_kalman_smooth positions
definition.dca: mean finite per-retained-trajlet minimum DCA; Rp=0.33 m

population_contract.publication_cv: complete unsampled consecutive 8+12 single-track windows at stride 1; positions=opentraj_kalman_smooth
